headline: Your website is healthy and easier to use.
summary: In June we fixed the mobile menu, described every gallery image for screen readers and rewrote nine page titles for search.
improvementsNote: The main changes this month, each tied to an area of ongoing care.

improvements.title: Mobile menu closes after a tap
improvements.body: The menu used to stay open after choosing a page. It now closes as expected.

improvements.title: Gallery images described
improvements.body: All 38 gallery images now have text descriptions for screen readers.

improvements.title: Page titles rewritten for search
improvements.body: Nine pages have clearer titles and descriptions in Google results.

improvements.title: Monthly backup verified
improvements.body: This month's backup was restored on a test copy and checked page by page.
